Bride Refuses Marriage to Intoxicated Groom

A bride in Kosmanda village, Chhattisgarh, refused to marry her groom after he arrived at the wedding ceremony in an intoxicated state. The groom reportedly stumbled during the rituals, leading the bride to call off the wedding. Her family supported her decision, and the groom's procession subsequently returned without the bride. The matter was later reported to the SP office.
